text: Visitors have noted issues with low lighting in exhibit areas and a lack of clear signage, which made navigation difficult and frustrating for some. Several reviews criticized the use of AI in the exhibits, describing it as excessive and unhelpful. Timed entry procedures caused confusion, with some guests unsure about when they could arrive and experiencing long lines during peak times. Food service also received negative comments, particularly regarding quality and wait times. Despite these concerns, the overall average rating remains above 4.6, with many visitors appreciating the interactive exhibits and architecture.
